Implementation Plan

Implementation plan for issue #9223: make release-gate clarify stalls diagnosable and fail fast on clarify's own failure comment

Planning ref: `git rev-parse HEAD` = `a638db873808068331eba28b4f629c7ca9bfea68`, branch `main` (integration branch mismatch: false).

This change only adds diagnostics and one early failure to the gate. It does not fix whatever stalled clarify on smoke issues #9206 and #9205. That cause can't be determined from this evidence.

## Files likely to change
- `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml`
- `tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_clarify_wait.py` (new)
- `changelog.d/9223-release-gate-clarify-stall-diagnostics.md` (new)

## Deferred scope
- The root cause that kept the e2e-smoke-test job's issue at ai:clarification for 30 idle minutes is not fixed here; it needs the Clarify run that the new diagnostics will name on the next gate run.
- The root cause that kept the e2e-alt-model-test job's issue at ai:clarification until its 75-minute deadline is not fixed here; it needs the Clarify run that the new timeout line will name on the next gate run.

## Acceptance
ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_clarify_wait.py red-on-base
ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_plan_polling_guard.py
ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_step_scripts_contract.py
ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_alt_model_cleanup_pr_selector.py
ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py
ACCEPTANCE: post-merge workflow .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml

## Automation / scheduler wiring (§20.E)
- **New scripts:** none. Only an existing workflow step and two existing steps' run bodies change, plus one new test file and one changelog fragment.
- **Entry point:** `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml`, unchanged triggers. The release gate run on `promote-candidate`.
  - Job `e2e-smoke-test`, step `Phase 1: Wait for clarify to complete` (`id: wait-clarify`).
  - Job `e2e-alt-model-test`, steps `Create alt-model smoke issue` (`id: create`) and `Wait for clarify→plan→implement (alt-model)` (`id: wait`).
- **Long-running supervisor:** none.
- **Database work:** none.
- **`docs/scripts-pending-removal.md` entry:** none (no new script).

## Functions or modules to implement

### A. `wait-clarify` step (lines 899-1043)

**A1. Comment read (replaces lines 1022-1031).**
- Make one read and keep it: `CLARIFY_COMMENTS_JSON=$(gh_api_safe_print "repos/${TEST_REPO}/issues/${ISSUE_NUMBER}/comments?per_page=100" || echo "")`.
  - This is the same endpoint the step reads today. Only `per_page` goes from 5 to 100. The issue-comments endpoint ignores `direction` and returns comments oldest first, so with 5 a failure comment after the fifth comment was never seen.
  - There is still one comment-list call per poll (§14).
- Rebuild `LAST_BOT_COMMENT` from the stored JSON with the same filter: `[.[]? | select(.user.login == "github-actions[bot]")] | .[0].body // ""`. Keep the existing `clarification.*needed|NEEDS_CLARIFICATION` grep, `status=clarification_needed` and its `::error::` text exactly as they are.

**A2. Extract the run ID from pipeline failure comments.** Use jq on the stored JSON only, and never print a comment body.
- Accept a comment only if its `author_association` is OWNER, MEMBER or COLLABORATOR, or its `user.login == "github-actions[bot]"`. Clarify posts with `GH_PAT` (`clarify.yml` lines 2337-2352), so it shows up as OWNER or COLLABORATOR.
- The body must start with `AI clarification workflow failed for ` (into `CLARIFY_FAILURE_RUN_ID`) or `AI clarification workflow was cancelled/timed out for ` (into `CLARIFY_CANCELLED_RUN_ID`).
- Get the ID with `capture("Run: https://github\\.com/(?<r>[^/ ]+/[^/ ]+)/actions/runs/(?<id>[0-9]{1,20})")`, then `select(.r == $repo)` with `--arg repo "$TEST_REPO"`, then take the last match's `.id`. Default to `""`. Use `2>/dev/null || echo ""` so a bad read fails open.
- Before using either ID, check it in bash with `=~ ^[0-9]+$`.

**A3. Fail fast, but only on the newest failed run.**
- When `CLARIFY_FAILURE_RUN_ID` is numeric and differs from `CLARIFY_FAILURE_CHECKED_ID` (initialised to `""` before the loop):
  - Set `CLARIFY_FAILURE_CHECKED_ID` to it.
  - Get `CLARIFY_LATEST_RUN_ID=$(capture_run_id "Clarif")`, using the existing title-scoped helper at lines 940-962.
- If the two IDs are equal:
  - print `::error::Clarify phase failed — pipeline failure comment on issue #${ISSUE_NUMBER} (Clarify run: https://github.com/${TEST_REPO}/actions/runs/${CLARIFY_FAILURE_RUN_ID})`;
  - write `status=clarify_failed` to `GITHUB_OUTPUT`;
  - `exit 1`.
- Otherwise print one `  ⚠ Clarify failure comment names run <id>; newer Clarify run <latest|unknown> exists — still waiting` line and keep polling.
- The printed URL is built from `TEST_REPO` and a numeric ID that the runs API confirmed, never from comment text.
- Put this block after the capacity check (lines 1016-1020) and after the A1 clarification-needed check, and before the inactivity timeout. The word "stalled" must not appear in it, because the contract test checks the order of the first `Clarify phase stalled`.

**A4. Timeout branch (lines 1033-1037).**
- Before the `::error::` line, set `CLARIFY_STALL_RUN_ID=$(capture_run_id "Clarif")`.
- Set `CLARIFY_STALL_NOTE`:
  - when the ID is numeric: ` (Clarify run: https://github.com/${TEST_REPO}/actions/runs/<id>)`;
  - otherwise: ` (no non-skipped Clarify run titled '${ISSUE_TITLE}' found)`.
  - When `CLARIFY_CANCELLED_RUN_ID` is numeric, also add ` (cancelled Clarify run: https://github.com/${TEST_REPO}/actions/runs/<id>)`.
- Change the line to `echo "::error::Clarify phase stalled — no activity for ${PHASE_TIMEOUT} minutes${CLARIFY_STALL_NOTE}"`.
- The literal prefix and `no activity for N minutes` stay unchanged, because `stall_window_minutes` in `scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py` line 865 parses them. `status=timeout` and `exit 1` also stay unchanged.

### B. Alt-model job

**B1. `create` step (lines 5192-5219).**
- Before the issue POST, set `ALT_CREATED_AT="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"`.
- Add two outputs: `created_after=<timestamp>` and `title=${TITLE}`. Step outputs are per-step, so these names don't collide.

**B2. `wait` step (lines 5221-5287).**
- Add env `ALT_ISSUE_TITLE: ${{ steps.create.outputs.title }}` and `ALT_CREATED_AFTER: ${{ steps.create.outputs.created_after }}`. They go through `env:` and are never inlined in the run body.
- Only on the deadline-exit path (after the `while`), and only when both variables are non-empty, run:
  `ALT_CLARIFY_RUN_ID=$( . ./scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh && find_latest_scoped_run_field "${TEST_REPO}" "${ALT_CREATED_AFTER}" "Clarif" "${ALT_ISSUE_TITLE}" id 10 ) || ALT_CLARIFY_RUN_ID=""`
  - The job checks out `ref: main` at line 5155, so the helper is there.
  - An empty title would turn off the title filter (see the comment at lines 916-920), which is why both variables must be set.
- Set `ALT_CLARIFY_RUN_NOTE` the same way as A4:
  - when `ALT_CLARIFY_RUN_ID` is numeric: ` (Clarify run: https://github.com/${TEST_REPO}/actions/runs/<id>)`;
  - otherwise: ` (no non-skipped Clarify run titled '...' found)`;
  - when either variable is missing: `""`.
- Change the line to `echo "::error::Alt-model run timed out before reaching review stage${ALT_CLARIFY_RUN_NOTE}"`, then `exit 1` as before.
- The polling loop and the failure-label path stay unchanged.

### C. Tests: `tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_clarify_wait.py` (new)
- Follow the harness in `tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_plan_polling_guard.py` (`STUB_GH`, `_phase_step_script`, `_run_phase_step`):
  - pull the step's `run` out of the YAML;
  - substitute `${{ steps.create-issue.outputs.created_after }}`;
  - put a fake `gh` (Python) and a no-op `sleep` on `PATH`;
  - serve comments from a `STUB_COMMENTS` JSON env var.
- For the alt-model step, use job `e2e-alt-model-test`, step `id: wait`, and a fake `date` that returns 0 on the first `+%s` call and then a large value, so the deadline passes at once.

## Data structures affected
- `wait-clarify` gets a new `status` value, `clarify_failed`. The release summary (line 3560) prints any non-`success` value as `FAILED (<status>)`, so it needs no change.
- The alt-model `create` step gets two new outputs, `created_after` and `title`.
- No new env vars, labels or log prefixes. I checked the new shell variable names against the workflow, and none is already used.

## API or interface changes
- No new GitHub API call on the normal polling path. The comment read is the existing call with a larger `per_page`.
- New reads happen only on terminal or failure paths:
  - `capture_run_id` (at most 5 attempts × 10 pages) once per distinct failure-comment run ID, and once at timeout;
  - `find_latest_scoped_run_field` (at most 10 pages) once at the alt-model deadline.

## Decisions

### D1 — Fail fast only when the failure comment names the newest scoped Clarify run
- Chosen: on a pipeline "failed for" comment, compare its run ID with `capture_run_id "Clarif"`. Fail with `clarify_failed` only when they match; otherwise keep waiting.
- Alternatives considered: fail on any matching comment, as the issue suggests; or never fail fast.
- Why: if clarify is re-triggered, an older failure comment must not fail a run that is still in progress. Comparing IDs also means the printed URL comes from the API, not from comment text (§6, correctness).

### D2 — Do not fail fast on "cancelled/timed out" comments; report them at timeout
- Chosen: record the run ID from the cancelled comment and include it in the timeout error line only.
- Alternatives considered: fail fast on both prefixes, as the issue suggests.
- Why: clarify's concurrency group is `cancel-in-progress: true` (`clarify.yml` line 52). A cancelled run there usually means a newer run replaced it, and the replacement may not be listed by the API yet. Failing on that comment could fail a h
